 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Rohit Sharma hoped to leave a forgettable start behind him when India meet New Zealand in the third ODI at Hamilton.
 The veteran opener has remained a fixture in the Indian side, and the five-match series began last week in Auckland. He arrived there on the back of a strong run at home against West Indies last month, so there was plenty of confidence around his batting.
